_meta.description: The Archiefwet retention schemas RetentionPolicy, RetentionSchedule and DocumentRetention (archived change 2026-06-14-bookkeeping-archiefwet-retention, REQ-RET-001 to REQ-RET-013). They were added to shillinq_register.json in 6df26567 (hydra-build #47, merged as 5078f97f) and lost when merge c0957515 (8 June 2026) kept development's register; SettingsService::seedRetentionPolicies() and RetentionGuard kept referring to them, so every install logged 'retention policy seeding failed'. Restored here as their own fragment; the retention dates are computed with x-openregister-calculations, the vocabulary OpenRegister keeps.

RetentionPolicy.title: Retention Policy
RetentionPolicy.description: An organization-wide, document-type-scoped retention rule per Archiefwet 1995. Declares the retention period (in years), legal-hold allowances, and exemption categories. Pure configuration metadata per REQ-RET-001 / REQ-RET-009.

slug.description: Stable key of the policy. The seeded defaults are matched on it, so a repair run never seeds one twice, and DocumentRetention.policyId may name it.

name.description: Human-readable name of the retention policy.

documentType.description: Classification of documents this policy governs. Drives policy selection when a DocumentRetention record is created.

retentionYears.description: Number of whole years a document must be retained from its start-of-retention marker before it becomes eligible for review and disposal.

legalHoldAllowed.description: Whether documents under this policy may be placed on a legal hold (litigation, court order, regulatory investigation) that overrides the standard schedule.

exemptionCategories.description: Categories of exemption recognised by this policy (e.g. court-order, regulatory-exception). Used to classify entries appended to DocumentRetention.exceptions[].

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the Administration owning an administration-specific override. When null, the policy is an organization-wide default per REQ-RET-009.

description.description: Operator-authored explanation of the regulatory basis for the retention period.

countByDocumentType.description: Number of retention policies per documentType, surfaces coverage gaps in the Retention Dashboard per REQ-RET-006.

RetentionSchedule.title: Retention Schedule
RetentionSchedule.description: The computed temporal schedule mapping a single document to its retention timeline. retentionEndDate and reviewDueDate are derived from startDate + the policy retentionYears per REQ-RET-002 / REQ-RET-013, they are read-only aggregations, not operator-editable.

documentId.description: Polymorphic FK to the document under retention (Invoice, Receipt, ledger entry, etc.). Stored as the document object UUID.

policyId.description: FK to the RetentionPolicy.id governing this document.

startDate.description: Start-of-retention marker (e.g. invoiceDate). The retention clock starts here.

retentionYears.description: Retention period copied from the governing RetentionPolicy at schedule-creation time, so historical schedules are stable when a policy is later amended.

retentionEndDate.description: Read-only computed date: startDate + retentionYears. Document becomes eligible for disposal after this date. Derived via x-openregister-calculations, do not set directly.

reviewDueDate.description: Read-only computed date: retentionEndDate - 30 days. Archiefwet requires review before disposal. Derived via x-openregister-calculations, do not set directly.

retentionEndDate.description: startDate plus retentionYears whole years (REQ-RET-002). JSON-AST: dateAdd(startDate, retentionYears, years).

reviewDueDate.description: 30 days before retentionEndDate: the Archiefwet review before disposal (REQ-RET-002, REQ-RET-004). JSON-AST: dateAdd(dateAdd(startDate, retentionYears, years), -30, days).

DocumentRetention.title: Document Retention
DocumentRetention.description: Per-document retention tracking: governing policy, computed schedule, current lifecycle status, legal-hold flag, and structured exceptions. The lifecycle (active → under-review → retained → scheduled-for-deletion → deleted) consumes OR's archival-destruction workflow per ADR-022 + REQ-RET-003. All transitions are audit-trailed by OR's AuditTrailService per REQ-RET-007.

documentId.description: Polymorphic FK to the document under retention (UUID of the Invoice, Receipt, ledger entry, etc.).

scheduleId.description: FK to the RetentionSchedule.id holding the computed dates for this document.

status.description: Current retention lifecycle state. Managed by the x-openregister-lifecycle engine consuming OR archival-destruction, transitions cannot be skipped.

reviewDueDate.description: Copied from the RetentionSchedule for fast lifecycle-guard evaluation (RetentionGuard::requiresReview). Read-only mirror of the schedule.

retentionEndDate.description: Copied from the RetentionSchedule for fast disposal-eligibility evaluation. Read-only mirror of the schedule.

legalHold.description: When true, automatic disposal is suspended regardless of retentionEndDate per REQ-RET-005 / REQ-RET-008. Changes are audit-trailed.

exceptions.description: Structured exception entries (legal holds, court orders, regulatory exemptions) appended over the document's lifetime per REQ-RET-005.

type.description: Exception category, drawn from the governing policy's exemptionCategories.

clearedDate.description: When the exception was cleared (null while active).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning the document. Scopes retention queries and IDOR-safe access per ADR-005.

active.label: Active
active.description: Document is within its retention period; no action due.

under-review.label: Under review
under-review.description: Review-due date reached; a records officer is reviewing the document before disposal per Archiefwet.

retained.label: Retained
retained.description: Review completed with a retain decision; document continues to be held until its retention end date.

scheduled-for-deletion.label: Scheduled for deletion
scheduled-for-deletion.description: Retention end date passed and no legal hold is active; document is queued for disposal authorisation.

deleted.label: Deleted
deleted.description: Disposal authorised and executed. Terminal state. The disposal action is captured immutably in the OR audit trail.

retention.description: Default Archiefwet retention envelope for financial records; the effective period is the governing RetentionPolicy.retentionYears per REQ-RET-001.

initiateReview.label: Initiate review
initiateReview.description: An authorised retention-manager starts the mandatory pre-disposal review. Blocked until the review-due date is reached and no legal hold suspends the document.

confirmRetention.label: Confirm retention
confirmRetention.description: The reviewer confirms the document must continue to be held.

scheduleDisposal.label: Schedule disposal
scheduleDisposal.description: Retention end date has passed; queue the document for disposal authorisation. Blocked while a legal hold is active.

executeDisposal.label: Execute disposal
executeDisposal.description: A document-disposal authority authorises and executes the deletion. Captured immutably in the OR audit trail with actor UID and reason.

overdueReviewCount.description: Count of DocumentRetention records whose review is overdue (REQ-RET-006). Powers the Overdue Reviews KPI on the Retention Dashboard.

activeLegalHoldCount.description: Count of documents currently under a legal hold (REQ-RET-006).

pendingDisposalCount.description: Count of documents queued for disposal authorisation (REQ-RET-006).
